title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — Design System v8 route class registration
purpose: Register the two accounting routes in the Design System v8 route policy, and nothing else. A page absent from that policy is unreachable: app/platform-v7/layout.tsx calls notFound() for any path isKnownProtectedPath() does not recognise, before it looks at a role. The file belongs to pc-crop-01b4's bounded scope, whose allow-list admits a change carrying that file alone — so this scope exists to let exactly one product file travel by itself, with the manifest landing first so the change that follows it can be a single file.
objective: Bounded registration of /platform-v7/accounting and /platform-v7/deals/<id>/accounting in the Design System v8 route class, with no other route changing class.
boundaries: No product file travels with this manifest; the registration is a separate pull request so that its diff is one file and pc-crop-01b4's bounded scope stays intact.
pc-crop-01b4.yml is neither modified nor weakened, and its authority is not taken.
routes.ts, cabinet-access-policy.ts and layout.tsx are out of scope.
No API, database, migration, RLS, MFA, production or hosting change.

The existing dead '/platform-v7/deals/' prefix entry is left as it is: removing its trailing slash would sweep every deal sub-route into the v8 class, which is a decision about other workstreams' screens.
No route other than the two accounting routes changes class.
Merge and green CI are not evidence that production changed.
requiredInvariants: Authority comes from this manifest's projectLockId and issue, never from the branch name.
The registration is expressible without wildcards, and this scope contains none.
noAutoMerge, noDirectPushToMain and noSelfModifyingWorkflow are untouched.
